challenge.method: Contrast an immediately preceding preamble with a comment elsewhere in a file and with a file importing C when cgo is disabled. Check the adjacent restrictions on references to C names.
challenge.results: The documented preamble condition is immediate adjacency to the special import. The go tool excludes files importing C when cgo is disabled. Static variables are an example of declarations that can be in the preamble but remain unavailable to Go references.

limitations: This verifies the documented behavior in the Go 1.23.0 cgo tool. Target availability and successful compilation of arbitrary preamble contents are outside the claim.
